editor.rationale: Reviewers support publication but want clarifications on reporting completeness and residual uncertainty.

concerns: Evidence base is complete but small (k=3 exhausts the full trial universe); heterogeneity and publication-bias diagnostics are structurally underpowered. Treat as a boundary condition; flag for living-review update when new trials accrue.
RoB 2.0: 2 high-risk + 6 some-concerns domains; add low-RoB sensitivity analysis.
No endpoint-matched published benchmark wired to this outcome.
DL estimator under-estimates τ² for k<10; add REML/Paule-Mandel sensitivity.
QoL / PROs reported in 2 trial(s) (CDR-SB) but not in headline pool; consider adding as a secondary analysis rather than omitting.
